title: Human medial temporal lobe single units during a verbal working memory task (Boran et al.): spike times and waveforms aligned to OpenNeuro ds004752
description: This BIDS derivative dataset provides single-unit microwire recordings from the human medial temporal lobe (hippocampus, entorhinal cortex, amygdala) of nine patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy performing a modified Sternberg verbal working memory task. It contains 1526 sorted units and over 1.5 million spike times, along with mean and standard deviation waveforms, electrode and anatomical mappings, and per-trial task properties. Subject, session and trial labels are aligned to OpenNeuro ds004752 / NEMAR on004752, which hosts the scalp and intracranial EEG of the same patients.
methods_description: Recordings used AdTech depth electrodes with microwires, acquired with a Neuralynx ATLAS system (microwires sampled at 32 kHz). Spikes were detected and sorted with Combinato (wavelet features and superparamagnetic clustering), followed by visual curation and merging of similar clusters. Patients performed a modified Sternberg task with set sizes of 4, 6 or 8 letters, presented in Presentation software, with about 50 trials per session.
